claims.statement: The EU AI Act framework requires high-risk systems to address dataset quality, logging, detailed documentation, human oversight, robustness, cybersecurity, and accuracy.

Joint AI Board and Medical Device Coordination Group guidance states that medical-device AI is high risk under the AI Act when it is a safety component or device and is subject to third-party conformity assessment under MDR or IVDR.

The Commission's revised software guidance distinguishes medical-device software qualification and classification, so intended purpose and versioned technical evidence are upstream commercial control points, not late-stage paperwork only.

contrary_evidence: Mature QMS, MLOps, requirements, and medical-device lifecycle platforms already cover adjacent traceability functions.
Many early biosignal startups will postpone compliance tooling until fundraising or a notified-body engagement.

economics.acquisition_route: Start with one EEG or ECG startup and one regulatory consultancy that can repeat the template across its client portfolio
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 35 customers at 140k PLN blended ARR yield 4.9M PLN ARR and about 2M PLN EBITDA by year 7. At 4x EBITDA and 65% founder ownership, equity is about 5.2M PLN in years 7 to 9; channel reuse is essential because direct enterprise selling would be too slow.
economics.founder_time: 18 to 22 hours weekly for the first integration, then 12 to 18 hours with regulatory implementation partners
economics.gross_margin_basis: Target 70% software gross margin and 40% to 55% blended contribution after specialist mapping support
economics.payback: The buyer case is fewer evidence-chasing weeks, fewer audit findings, and faster controlled releases; quantify those outcomes before annual pricing
economics.pricing: 40,000 to 100,000 PLN onboarding plus 60,000 to 180,000 PLN per regulated model annually
economics.retention_or_repeat: Every model, dataset, claim, control, and release version must remain traceable through surveillance and recertification

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A proprietary map from auditor findings and biosignal failure modes to the exact experiments, controls, and evidence that resolved them
fingerprint.customer: Small EU medical-device teams building AI from EEG, ECG, sleep, gait, or wearable sensor data
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Notified-body preparation consultants, biosignal hardware vendors, CROs, and medtech accelerators
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Evidence-graph software with regulated-product onboarding and expert-reviewed mapping templates
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The device manufacturer pays at model onboarding and annually per regulated product or technical file
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A model version, intended-purpose claim, risk control, or conformity-assessment packet changes

founder_fit: Very strong intersection of data science, neuroscience, biosignals, and systems thinking, with an EU location advantage. The founder can build integrations and evidence logic without being a public-facing clinician, but needs a paid MDR/IVDR quality expert and strict separation from employer IP.
risks: Customers may treat the graph as certification or legal advice.
Integrations touch proprietary models, clinical datasets, and cybersecurity-sensitive development systems.
Long enterprise sales and validation work can exceed the founder's part-time capacity.

structure.control_point: The versioned link between each intended claim or risk control and its exact supporting experiment
structure.critical_dependency: Regulatory consultants and auditors must value the evidence graph enough to make it part of their repeatable client workflow

thesis: Build a traceability layer specifically for EU teams developing EEG, ECG, sleep, gait, or wearable medical-device AI. It would connect dataset versions, intended-purpose claims, risk controls, model runs, subgroup tests, human-oversight tests, and released software into an auditor-readable evidence graph. The wedge is automatic proof that each current claim and control points to the exact experiment and data version, complementing rather than replacing a QMS or notified-body assessment.
title: Experiment-to-Technical-File Evidence Graph for Biosignal AI
uncertainties: Whether a biosignal specialization produces enough willingness-to-pay beyond generic QMS integrations.
Which evidence mappings notified bodies will consistently recognize as useful.
Exact application timing and interaction of AI Act, MDR, and IVDR duties for each customer.
